facts.text: The North Star Promise Scholarship covers up to 100% of remaining tuition and mandatory fees for eligible Minnesota students from families with income below $80,000.

sources.title: North Star Promise Scholarship | Minnesota State University, Mankato
sources.quote: The North Star Promise Scholarship creates a tuition- and fee-free pathway to higher education for qualifying Minnesota students. It's a “last-dollar” scholarship, meaning it covers any remaining tuition and mandatory fees.
